_comment: Ready-made baskets for lacanastaindex.com/canastas/. Each ingredient is found in the day's prices either through a basket type (the curated products the index follows) or through a search term plus name rules. Quantities: per person (asado) or per person per week (the others). kcal is an approximate value per unit (kg, l or un) from standard food tables. From 6 November 2026 the catalogue also has the products of the app's extra searches (EXTRA_SEARCHES in scrape_supermarkets.py): more beef cuts, pork, chicken, fish, deli, fresh pasta, fruit and veg, pantry, drinks and cleaning.

baskets.desc_es: Carne, chorizo, pan, carbón, provoleta, ensalada y bebida. Cantidades por persona: 450 g de carne, un chorizo, media morcilla y una botella de vino cada 3.
baskets.desc_en: Meat, chorizo, bread, charcoal, provoleta, salad and drinks. Per person: 450 g of meat, one chorizo, half a morcilla and a bottle of wine for every 3 people.

baskets.desc_es: Una persona, 7 días: avena, leche, yogur, huevos, pollo, atún, lentejas, arroz, pan, frutas, verduras, queso, aceite y yerba. Unas 2.000 calorías por día. Pensada para alguien que cocina en casa, por ejemplo un jubilado.
baskets.desc_en: One person, 7 days: oats, milk, yoghurt, eggs, chicken, tuna, lentils, rice, bread, fruit, vegetables, cheese, oil and yerba. About 2,000 calories a day. For someone who cooks at home, for example a pensioner.

baskets.desc_es: Una persona, 7 días, lo más barato que rinde: fideos, arroz, puré de tomate, huevos, pan, leche, yerba, azúcar, carne picada, pollo, papa, cebolla, banana, galletitas, aceite, queso, mayonesa y gaseosa.
baskets.desc_en: One person, 7 days, cheap and filling: pasta, rice, tomato purée, eggs, bread, milk, yerba, sugar, minced beef, chicken, potatoes, onions, bananas, biscuits, oil, cheese, mayonnaise and soft drink.
